description: Town and 'death traps' text hold position at tile resolution.

Three microbes, no labels.

Vomiting painting steady on board.

Street and figure only, before the bubble.

White curved arrow appears pointing at figure's torso.
Figure and houses shift positions and look larger across tiles, suggesting slow camera push or zoom.

Sign moves back up slightly (small bounce).
Lying figure (torso at 10402, head from 10404) slides in from left over the sack.
Bucket and background posts move across tiles in the same period, consistent with a pan or zoom; mechanism undetermined.
Figure and sack look static at tile resolution.
Empty desk, no overlay text.
'not for you' appears small at 10795 and increases in size and moves lower through 10798.
Banner and shelves look slightly larger toward 10801: slow push-in.
Figure, label, arrows, crown, mitre mostly steady; slight rightward drift of crown/mitre.
Figure and 'real doctors' label gone by 10917 (no visible gradual exit in strip).
Crown, mitre and arrows move right out of frame.
'you?' text appears tiny and grows toward centre.
Bowl emerges from behind figure and moves left and down; frame-to-frame step shrinks until it rests by about 11110-11112.
Tooth, scissors, knife and figure unchanged.
